# --- memfw-pipeline-admitted-view.service ---
# Generated by memfw-pipeline for stage admitted-view. Review before installing.
# Exit 75 = another run holds the lock (success). 1 inputs unavailable, 2 setup,
# 3 build/verify/publish failed, 4 a post-publish step failed, 5 shrink refused:
# failures, so `systemctl --failed` shows them; status.json says which.
[Unit]
Description=memfw pipeline: admitted-view
RequiresMountsFor=/srv/memfw/pipeline-state/admitted-view /srv/memfw/derived /srv/memfw/authority

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=memfw
UMask=0077
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=idle
UnsetEnvironment=HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY http_proxy https_proxy all_proxy
Environment=NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost,::1
Environment=MEMFW_EMBEDDING_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/embeddings
ExecStart=/opt/memfw/venv/bin/python -I -m memfw_pipeline run admitted-view --config /srv/memfw/pipeline.toml
SuccessExitStatus=75
TimeoutStartSec=6000
# Loopback network only.
IPAddressDeny=any
IPAddressAllow=localhost
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
# uid 0 + AF_UNIX could still connect() to these sockets and escape the sandbox.
InaccessiblePaths=-/run/docker.sock -/var/run/docker.sock -/run/containerd/containerd.sock -/run/podman/podman.sock -/run/dbus -/run/systemd/private
NoNewPrivileges=true
# Capabilities. The default is none: a stage that runs as root still cannot read
# files it does not own unless it is given CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH (read and list).
# Some filesystems add their own ACL layer on top of the mode bits; there
# CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH alone can fail to list another user's 0700 directories and
# CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE is needed for READS. Writes outside ReadWritePaths stay
# impossible either way (ProtectSystem=strict makes the rest read-only). Check the
# first run (`journalctl -u`): an empty build is refused by the shrink guard.
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/srv/memfw/pipeline-state/admitted-view /srv/memfw/derived
ReadOnlyPaths=/srv/memfw/authority
ProtectHome=read-only
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectKernelLogs=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
LockPersonality=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
RestrictRealtime=true
RestrictNamespaces=true
SystemCallArchitectures=native
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM

# --- memfw-pipeline-admitted-view.timer ---
[Unit]
Description=memfw pipeline: admitted-view (timer)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:30:00
RandomizedDelaySec=600
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
